title: Driftward catalog
description: Ships, stations and heavy hulls as data (src/catalog.json): size classes, factions with their style grammar, part templates, loadouts and lines, station archetypes and heavy hulls. src/gen.js turns a line, a class and a seed into a ship; npm run check validates the catalog against this and cross-checks its ids (tools/validate.js).

id.description: Unique in its faction: brand prefix, role, name (cn.hull.armor).

role.description: Where the assembler puts it (src/gen.js assemble): the core runs the ship's length; hull plates sit along it; wings and fins are outlines from its sides; nacelles hang off struts with an engine bell; engines are bells at the stern; weapons are turrets with barrels; pods ride the flanks; the bridge on the spine; rings circle it; cargo is rows of containers.

prim.description: Its shape: trap (a tapered body: rear and nose half-widths, len), ucap (a capsule: rear, nose or r, len), rbox (a rounded box: hw, len, rad), circle (r), spine (a core of segs boxes with gaps, tapering). Wings, fins, engines, weapons, rings and cargo have their own shapes and need none.

prof.description: Its edge profile; the style's bevel if not given.

paint.description: any: a random hull colour; trim: the trim colour. Otherwise by role.

w.description: Weight when the assembler picks among a role's templates (default 1); cargo: a container's half-width, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

len.description: Length, as a fraction of the ship's length L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

rear.description: Trap, ucap, engine: half-width at the rear, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

nose.description: Trap, ucap: half-width at the nose, a fraction of L; nacelle: the nose as a fraction of its radius. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

front.description: Engine: the bell's half-width at its front, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

hw.description: Rbox, spine: half-width, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

r.description: Radius, a fraction of L (circle, ucap, nacelle, weapon); ring: times the core's half-width there. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

rad.description: Rbox: corner radius, a fraction of its smaller half-size.

t.description: Ring: thickness, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

along.description: Hull: where along the core, -0.5 stern to 0.5 nose. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

out.description: Hull: how far out, in the core's half-widths at that point. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

ang.description: Hull: angle, degrees. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

at.description: Where along the core, -0.5 stern to 0.5 nose (a number or [min, max]); a fin: rear, wingtip, or mixed (either).

z.description: Height of its base, in core heights. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

H.description: Its height (thickness for the bake), in core heights; the core's, as a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

span.description: Wing, fin: span, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

root.description: Wing, fin: root chord, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

tip.description: Wing, fin: tip chord, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

sweep.description: Wing, fin: leading-edge sweep, back per unit of span. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

curve.description: Wing, fin: how much its edges bow.

gap.description: Spine: the gap between segments, a fraction of each (negative overlaps); nacelle: its gap from the hull, in its radii; ring: an opening, degrees. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

segs.description: Spine: segments. An integer, or [min, max] to pick between.

taper.description: Spine: the last segment's width over the first's. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

blen.description: Weapon: barrel length, a fraction of L. A number, or [min, max] to pick between.

bw.description: Weapon: barrel half-width, a fraction of L.

style.description: Weapon: a turret, a glowing blister, or a drill with a hot tip.

across.description: Cargo: columns of containers a side.

from.description: Cargo: where the rows start along the core, 0 stern to 1 nose.

fill.description: Cargo: the chance a slot holds a container.

stack.description: Cargo: the chance of a second tier.

part.description: A part template: the assembler picks templates by role and samples each range per ship. Shape values are fractions of the ship's length L; z and H of a non-core part are in core heights.

loadout.description: How many of each role a hull of this class gets (a mirrored pair counts once; cargo: columns a side).

core.description: The core templates (part ids, role core) a hull of this class may take.

panelSpacing.description: Panel size, metres (the same on every hull class).

hull.description: Hull colours; the core takes the first.

cargo.description: Container colours (cargo parts); a shipping-line set if not given.

standoff.description: Its distance from the hull, a fraction of L.

flight.description: Multipliers on the size class's flight numbers (a line's multiply its faction's).

well.description: How much gravity wells pull it.

items.description: A size class (I to V): its length, bake resolution and flight numbers.

union.description: hard: parts meet at seams; smooth: they blend into one skin.

blend.description: Smooth union's blend radius, a fraction of L.

symmetry.description: The chance a part is mirrored exactly; below 1, the other side may be re-rolled or left off.

drift.description: How much a mirrored copy differs.

posJitter.description: Random offset of parts, a fraction of L.

angleQuant.description: Angles snap to this many degrees (0: free).

bevelW.description: Bevel width, a fraction of a part's inner radius.

hull.description: Hull colours; the core takes the first.

cargo.description: Container colours (cargo parts); a shipping-line set if not given.

standoff.description: Its distance from the hull, a fraction of L.

style.description: The faction's style grammar: every line's, unless the line patches it.

series.description: Each class's hull name, Class I first (one per size; empty where the line builds none).

classes.description: The classes it builds; all if not given.

unique.description: One special hull (a container ship), built only in its classes.

hullFrom.description: Another line of this faction whose hulls it shares: the same seed gives the same vessel, outfitted differently.

drop.description: Faction part ids this line leaves out.

union.description: hard: parts meet at seams; smooth: they blend into one skin.

blend.description: Smooth union's blend radius, a fraction of L.

symmetry.description: The chance a part is mirrored exactly; below 1, the other side may be re-rolled or left off.

drift.description: How much a mirrored copy differs.

posJitter.description: Random offset of parts, a fraction of L.

angleQuant.description: Angles snap to this many degrees (0: free).

bevelW.description: Bevel width, a fraction of a part's inner radius.

style.description: A patch on the faction's style: only what differs (merged key by key).

loadout.description: Loadout entries that differ from the faction's, per class.

core.description: Core templates that differ from the faction's, per class.

items.description: A line: a faction's family of hulls (military, civilian, a unique hull), overriding what differs.
A faction: a style, part templates, a core and loadout per class, and its lines.

detailScale.description: Paneling scale, so detail stays legible at kilometre size.

heavies.description: Specialist hulls built like stations (the lab's Heavies tab).
